status: partial evidence; not a completion or human acceptance
purpose: Exercise real enabled QtQuick controls on the Controls page and multiline TextArea for delayed hint onset, stable placement, non-overlap, screen bounds and closure after pointer exit.

method.input: synthetic pointer motion only to the isolated gallery on Xephyr :76
method.scope: Controls tab controls, Save button and Scroll tab TextArea. TableView delegate and horizontal/vertical scrollbars were not exercised. Disabled controls were excluded because they do not accept hover.
method.delay: No hint at 300 ms; observed onset from pointer motion 700-900 ms (750 ms is configured; polling is 50 ms).
method.stability: 400 ms unchanged placement; closes 150-350 ms after pointer leaves.
method.visual: Each tested tooltip stayed inside the screen and did not overlap its owning control. No pixel/history comparison or human review.
